title: Blakey Rites Are Held At Savoy Church Monday
text:
Blakey Rites Are Held At Savoy Church Monday

[The Herald News Service.]

SAVOY, July 22.—S. R. Blakey, 71, died Sunday after an extended illness at his home in the Elizabeth Grove community. Funeral services were held Monday afternoon at the Methodist Church here with the Rev. E. J. Holifield officiating. Burial was in Sunnyside Cemetery here.

He was born March 12, 1870, in Grayson county, son of Mr. and Mrs. J. W. Blakey. He was married March 2, 1890, to Rebecca Wrenn. He had lived near Savoy for many years.

Surviving are his widow; two daughters, Mrs. George Short and Mrs. R. C. Elk of Savoy; two sons, J. T. and C. A. Blakey of Savoy; a sister, Mrs. Fannie Badgett of Whitewright; a brother, T. E. Blakey of Savoy; 14 grandchildren and three great-grandchildren.

[Handwritten note at bottom:] Born Feb 12 / 1870
notes: Handwritten annotation at bottom reads 'Born Feb 12 / 1870' — differs from printed text which says March 12, 1870.
